summary: This room is the palace's operational core — STIGMERGY, SUBSTRATE, ROSETTA, Trickster, Project Stewardship System — crossed with a scatter of design-philosophy and pedagogy entries (Progressive Staging, Songlines, Striatum, Scale-Stratified Identity) that folders keep apart but that keep independently landing on the same shapes. The community cut surfaced two real cross-domain patterns hiding in plain sight: "additive, never-retroactive staging" shows up almost word-for-word in a synth-pedagogy method (Progressive Staging), a palace-governance principle (The Palace Hardens Around Values), and a stewardship posture table (Project Stewardship System) without any of the three citing the others; and "state what was verified, not what's assumed forever" shows up independently in Surfaces and Capabilities, The Substrate Drifts, and Tool Builder as the same epistemic discipline for a live, drifting substrate. It also found a clean case of an entry naming its own genus in its opening sentence and not linking it (The Cooperation Path calling itself "a named songline" with Songlines sitting unlinked in the same room), a required-field gap (Trickster Commit has no `born`), a composting entry whose deletion is overdue for confirmation (Tristitia Generator, already folded into Spinoza Conatus), and a stale revival condition (Walk That Weaves is waiting on "Swarm Weave ceremony-ified and running cleanly," which Swarm Weave's own current forward_vector says already happened). Nothing here needed forcing — the room is clean, just under-cross-referenced.

typed_relations.rationale: The Cooperation Path opens by defining itself as "A named songline through the palace, tracing how a story became a principle" — it names its own genus and doesn't link it, and Songlines sits in the same room unlinked to it.
typed_relations.evidence: "A named songline through the palace, tracing how a story became a principle, grounded in biology, rooted in philosophy, expressed as pedagogy, and scaled into a framework." (The Cooperation Path.md:37)

typed_relations.label: every-stage-ships
typed_relations.rationale: Both independently arrived at the same rule — every stage must be a complete, shippable thing, not a stepping stone — one in synth pedagogy, one in agent stewardship. This directly answers Progressive Staging's own open question about whether the method extends to collaborative AI development.
typed_relations.evidence: "No stage is a stepping stone that exists only to reach the next one" (Progressive Staging.md:33) / "every stage ships something" and the stage-conditional posture table (Project Stewardship System.md:119, 292)

typed_relations.label: additive-compounding
typed_relations.rationale: Cross-domain structural identity: a design method for building instruments and the palace's own governing philosophy both insist complexity compounds by addition, never by invalidating what came before.
typed_relations.evidence: "Additive complexity, never retroactive... Nothing is thrown away; everything is extended" (Progressive Staging.md:39) / "Each honest decision, deposited and kept, makes the next decision more determined" (The Palace Hardens Around Values.md:40)

typed_relations.label: verified-not-assumed
typed_relations.rationale: Two entries in different registers (execution-environment capability deltas vs. blackboard data) independently derived the same epistemic discipline for a live, moving palace.
typed_relations.evidence: "State what was verified and when, not what is assumed to be true forever" (Surfaces and Capabilities.md:42) / "the palace blackboard as static and uniform when it is in fact living and heterogeneous" (The Substrate Drifts.md:32)

typed_relations.rationale: Tool Builder is the general checklist ("read it before you build"); The Substrate Drifts is a concrete scar of exactly the failure mode Tool Builder warns against.
